resources.string: Check links and senders with ScamShield servers. Only the sender, the links and the kind of warning signs are sent — not your message text.
Also send the full text of incoming messages for better checks.
Automated checks can be wrong. A warning is not a legal finding.
Do not tap links, call back, share OTPs or install apps from this message.
When a message is surely fraud
ScamShield sends the message, the other messages from that same sender, and the analysis to the cyber-crime cell and the organisation being imitated — without asking.
You see a Report button on the message and decide each time. Nothing is sent until you confirm.

Labels appear only after ScamShield has checked the sender against its database and checked every link (threat databases, Google Safe Browsing, security DNS, website age, isolated browser). Surely fraud = confirmed by a database or a link check. Surely spam = strong scam/spam signs, not confirmed by any database. Everything else shows no label.
Without server checks, ScamShield works as a normal SMS app and shows no labels.
